title: EC 1.2.4: PCA of Conjoint triad
caption: PCA projection of all 1011 proteins in the EC 1.2.4 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.11. The first two components explain 12.2% and 4.9% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
